decision: Use one L40S allocation to convert V18's valid stock-vLLM semantic control into paired quality, fixed c1/c8 SLO/economics, and conditional trace evidence. The changed parser follows vLLM 0.15's official completion response schema; stage isolation prevents a quality failure from suppressing already-sunk performance measurement.

causal_hypothesis.primary: Reading prompt_token_ids and prompt_logprobs from choices[0] will produce valid runtime teacher-forced NLL evidence. The semantically valid public AWQ checkpoint may preserve paired quality and run cheaply enough on L40S to beat complete BF16 H100 full-VM cost.
causal_hypothesis.stock_control: V13 complete BF16 H100: c1 87.1156 tok/s; c8 305.0449 tok/s; fixed SLO pass; compact quality 0.333; NLL 7.6455; absolute gate fails; $3.52799/M output tokens derived.
causal_hypothesis.semantic_control: V18 stock vLLM loaded all four AWQ shards and passed exact deterministic JSON twice, isolating V15's custom SGLang path rather than the checkpoint as the sufficient cause of gibberish.
causal_hypothesis.expected_direction: Completion-choice parsing passes. Paired output regressions and NLL are uncertain. L40S c8 must exceed 67.565 tok/s to beat BF16 H100 cost and 270.872 tok/s to beat the historical $0.88/M anchor.
causal_hypothesis.falsification_value: Paired quality/NLL failure rejects quality-adjusted economics. Fixed performance below 67.565 tok/s rejects even a BF16 H100 cost win. Semantics failure would contradict V18 and stop downstream arms.

changed_from_v18.quality_observer: Parse vLLM 0.15 CompletionResponseChoice.prompt_token_ids and .prompt_logprobs rather than nonexistent top-level fields, with an offline response-shape regression test.
changed_from_v18.stage_isolation: After semantic pass, a quality-stage exception is recorded but fixed c1/c8 performance still runs because setup is sunk.
changed_from_v18.keepalive: Typed allocation wrappers containing top-level or nested harness errors now open the same 600-second in-place repair window as missing typed results.
changed_from_v18.repeat_classification: Material observer, experiment-flow, and keepalive corrections; V18 never executed paired scoring or fixed performance.

stop_rules.preflight: Any targeted runtime/CUDA or identity failure stops before transfer/load.
stop_rules.semantic: Any HTTP, nondeterminism, parse, or object failure stops downstream arms.
stop_rules.quality: A valid paired/NLL failure suppresses tracing and quality-adjusted claims but does not suppress fixed performance.
stop_rules.performance: Geometry, cache, SLO, or below-67.565 tok/s failure rejects economics.
stop_rules.repair: Any top-level or nested harness/infrastructure error holds the allocation up to 600 seconds for a materially changed immediate test. A completed scientific result, safety/spend stop, or repair preparation over ten minutes tears down.
stop_rules.cleanup: Always retrieve/hash, delete instance/disk, and verify zero.
